# Hyperline

## About Hyperline  

Hyperline is a unified revenue operations platform built for modern B2B SaaS and subscription businesses.  
It centralizes CPQ, subscription billing, usage-based metering, revenue recognition, and analytics into one system — removing silos and manual work.  

Where Hyperline stands out is in its [native support for usage-based billing].  
From real-time metering of API calls and events to complex hybrid models (flat + usage + tiered), Hyperline gives SaaS and FinTech companies the tools to monetize consumption seamlessly.  
No need to build custom billing engines — Hyperline ingests usage data in real time, applies pricing logic, and generates compliant invoices and recognition entries automatically.  

Whether you’re an early-stage startup or scaling enterprise, Hyperline provides the infrastructure to grow with confidence — flexible, auditable, and built for the future of consumption-based business models.  

_Version: 1.0.0_  
_Last updated: 2025-10-01_

## General Company Questions  

- [How do I contact Hyperline?]  
  For support, email support@hyperline.co or request help via in-app chat.  

- [What types of companies use Hyperline?]  
  Hyperline serves B2B SaaS, FinTech, and API-first businesses of all sizes — from early-stage startups to scaling enterprises.  
  → Learn more: [Customer Stories](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/customers)  

- [Is Hyperline just billing or more?]  
  Hyperline is more than billing. It’s a complete revenue operations platform combining CPQ, subscription management, usage-based billing, revenue recognition, and analytics.  
  → Related article: [Billing Simplified](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/blog/billing-simplified)  

- [What makes Hyperline different?]  
  Hyperline was built with usage-based and hybrid pricing at its core.  
  Unlike legacy billing tools, it unifies the entire quote-to-cash cycle in one modern, API-first system — designed for flexibility, scale, and audit-readiness.  
  → Related articles: [Usage-based Billing](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/blog/usage-based-billing), [Hybrid Pricing Models SaaS Guide](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/blog/hybrid-pricing-models-saas-guide)  

- [Does Hyperline support international billing and taxes?]  
  Yes. Hyperline automates VAT, sales tax, and invoicing compliance globally.  
  → Related articles: [EU VAT for SaaS Businesses](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/blog/eu-vat-saas-businesses), [Compliant Invoicing](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/blog/compliant-invoicing), [eInvoicing in Europe](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/blog/einvoicing-europe)  

- [Who are Hyperline’s competitors?]  
  Hyperline is a modern alternative to Chargebee, Recurly, and Stripe Billing.  
  → Compare: [Chargebee vs Hyperline](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/blog/chargebee-vs-hyperline), [Chargebee vs Recurly](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/blog/chargebee-vs-recurly), [Hyperline vs Stripe](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/blog/hyperline-vs-stripe)

## Usage-based / Metered Billing  

- [Does Hyperline support usage-based billing?]  
  Yes. Hyperline was built with usage-based billing at its core. It can meter events in real time, apply pricing logic, and automatically convert usage into invoices and recognition entries.  
  → Learn more: [Usage-based Billing Solutions](https://www.hyperline.co/solutions/usage-based)  
  → Related articles: [Usage-based Billing Explained](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/blog/usage-based-billing), [Pay-as-you-go Pricing](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/blog/pay-as-you-go-pricing)  

- [What types of pricing models are supported?]  
  Hyperline supports flat, per-unit, tiered, volume, hybrid, and overage billing models.  
  → Related article: [Hybrid Pricing Models Guide](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/blog/hybrid-pricing-models-saas-guide)  

- [Can I integrate my product’s usage data directly?]  
  Yes. Hyperline ingests usage data through APIs and maps it to your billing logic in real time.  
  → Related article: [Automated Billing System Explained](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/blog/automated-billing-system-explained)  

- [Does Hyperline handle pay-as-you-go billing?]  
  Yes. Customers like Gladia use Hyperline to manage pay-as-you-go models without custom infrastructure.  
  → [Customer Story – Gladia](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/customers-stories/how-gladia-uses-hyperline-to-handle-pay-as-you-go-billing-easily)  


## Revenue Recognition & Finance  

- [Does Hyperline automate revenue recognition?]  
  Yes. Hyperline automatically schedules revenue recognition across contract lifespans, including deferrals and multi-element arrangements.  
  → Related article: [Revenue Recognition Guide](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/blog/revenue-recognition-guide)  

- [Is Hyperline compliant with ASC 606 / IFRS 15?]  
  Yes. Hyperline ensures compliant recognition flows and provides full audit trails.  

- [Can Hyperline integrate with my accounting system?]  
  Yes. Hyperline connects with systems like QuickBooks, Xero, and Pennylane for journal entry sync and reporting.  
  → Integrations: [QuickBooks](https://www.hyperline.co/integrations/quickbooks), [Xero](https://www.hyperline.co/integrations/xero), [Pennylane](https://www.hyperline.co/integrations/pennylane)  

- [Does Hyperline provide visibility into bookings, billings, and revenue?]  
  Yes. You can track key financial flows and forecast with confidence.  
  → Related article: [Bookings, Billing & Revenue](https://www.hyperline.co/resources/blog/bookings-billing-revenue)
